REACHED THE GOAL.

I added five errands and chores. Pressing Enter added tasks quickly, and the remaining-task count updated correctly. Editing worked through the visible Edit and Save buttons, checkboxes clearly marked tasks complete, and the Active and Completed filters showed the expected items.

Two things behaved differently from what I expected:

- While editing, pressing Enter did not save the change; I had to click Save.
- After refreshing the page, all five tasks disappeared and the app returned to “Nothing here yet” with “0 left.” I expected a to-do app to retain my list.

I hesitated over whether the list was intentionally temporary, but the screen did not warn me that refreshing would erase it. I would not keep using Taskly for a weekly list unless tasks persist between visits.
